build: production-source (npm run build, then Electron from the repository)
hardware: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X, 12 logical CPUs, 31.9 GB RAM, Windows 11 Home 10.0.26300
method: node scripts/measure-performance.mjs: isolated profile, start hidden, clipboard/context/weather off, startup settled 10 s, three snapshots 5 s apart of Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfProc_Process for the full parent/child tree. The tree includes a cmd.exe and conhost.exe that Playwright's launcher adds on this machine (about 9 MB).

runs.change: before: optional modules and per-window screens, main window still created hidden
after: main window created only when shown

limits: Short source-build runs, not a packaged build, task peak or soak test. Display scale and power mode were not recorded.
